title: A machine with itself: only the diagonal
notes: A and B are the same machine with different state names. They always move the same way, so the product only reaches (p0, q0) and (p1, q1), 2 of the 4 pairs. The union of a language with itself is the language: the best case for the product's size.
ops: start p0; accept p1; p0 a -> p0; p0 b -> p1; p1 a -> p0; p1 b -> p1 | start q0; accept q1; q0 a -> q0; q0 b -> q1; q1 a -> q0; q1 b -> q1
